run_safe_shell_command: run a validated shell command with pipes and conditionals using SafeShell.run with an allowlist
validate_shell_command: validate a shell command string against forbidden patterns and an allowlist using SafeShell._validate_command
tokenize_and_split_command: tokenize a shell command using shlex and split into segments on pipe and conditional operators
configure_safe_shell: configure a SafeShell instance with repo root, agent role, timeout, and allowed environment variables
handle_shell_tool_call: handle a shell tool call from an agent by routing through SafeShellToolsMixin.handle_shell_tool
